title: Deep Learning in Spinal Endoscopy: U-Net Models for Neural Tissue Detection.
summary: U-Net segmentation detected neural tissue in videos from spinal endoscopy cases, with reported held-out segmentation metrics. This is a pilot technical result and does not establish surgical benefit.
